tools.name: company_search
tools.description: Search Companies House by name. Returns company number, status, type, incorporation date, address. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Full Companies House profile for a company number: status, SIC codes, registered office, accounts and confirmation statement due dates and overdue flags, charges and insolvency flags. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_officers
tools.description: Directors and secretaries for a company number, with appointment and resignation dates. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_pscs
tools.description: Persons with significant control (beneficial owners) for a company number. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_filings
tools.description: Filing history for a company number (accounts, confirmation statements, officer changes, charges). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: companies_incorporated
tools.description: Find companies by incorporation date range, SIC codes, status, location or name fragment (Companies House advanced search). New-business lead lists. (cost: 2 credits)

tools.name: officer_appointments
tools.description: All directorships a person holds or has held across UK companies (Companies House appointments). Find every company a director is tied to, for due diligence and conflict checks. Pass a name or an officerId. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: disqualified_officers
tools.description: Search the UK register of disqualified company directors by name. Check whether a person has been banned from running a company, for KYB, onboarding and fraud screening. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_charges
tools.description: Registered charges and mortgages (secured debt) against a UK company number: status, amounts, who the debt is owed to. For credit, lending and due-diligence checks. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_insolvency
tools.description: Insolvency cases for a UK company number from Companies House: liquidation, administration, receivership, with dates and the insolvency practitioners handling it. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: kyb_check
tools.description: Full KYB (know your business) check on a UK company number in one call: profile and status, officers, owners (PSCs), overdue filings, registered charges, insolvency, a disqualified-director screen on the board, and Gazette notices, with a risk summary.
